title: Heavy to Very Heavy Rain Alert
description: Intense spells of rain likely across Chamoli and Rudraprayag districts during next 24 hours. Possibility of localized landslides along ghat roads.

title: Active Slope Creep Warning
description: Continuous ground displacement sensors detected active slope creep on Joshimath-Auli spur. Residents in Ward 1 and 2 advised to stage for relocation.

title: Alaknanda Warning Level Exceeded
description: Water level at Marwari bridge gauge station crossed warning mark of 1352.0m (current: 1352.8m). Low-lying habitations alert issued.
